explanation: Near-simultaneous elastic contacts in the collapsing vertical stack plus floor bounce at coarse dt=0.01 inject energy: impulses applied sequentially to deeply interpenetrated bodies with positional correction add net velocity (light bodies reach ~160-205 m/s by steps 218-220), driving total energy from ~6367 J to 7177 J beyond the 10%+5J bound. Finer dt=0.001 resolves contacts separately and conserves energy.
